security_subject_or_principal: Peer/client or user presenting identity/configuration keys
protected_target_or_security_object: Cluster membership or security-sensitive configuration options
attacker_controlled_input_or_trigger: User-controlled identity component (e.g., SASL instance part) or configuration key whose absence/value influences authorization
decisive_security_relation: Authorization logic branches based on presence/value of the key; missing/optional component causes checks to be skipped
required_validation_or_authorization_con: Enforce presence and validation of the key/identity component before allowing privileged operation
security_sensitive_effect: Join a cluster or toggle sensitive parameters without proper authorization
